recipes.title: No-Bake Mango Swirl Protein Cheesecake

items.i: gelatin (or 1 tbsp), bloomed and dissolved in a little hot water

steps: Mix the crushed biscuits with the melted butter and press firmly into a lined springform pan. Chill while you make the filling.
Blend the mango with the honey and lime juice until smooth.
Beat the cream cheese, Greek yogurt, whey and honey until smooth, then whisk in the dissolved gelatin.
Pour the filling over the base, dollop the mango purée on top and swirl it through with a knife.
Refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight until firm, then slice.
recipes.notes: Estimated recipe: the creator only sends the full recipe by DM ("comment Mango"), so ingredients, amounts and macros are estimates built from the video. He says the whole cake has about 150 g protein.
